statement: No top-3 compute jurisdiction bans or licenses open-weight release at the frontier tier (official gazettes; by 2028-06-30)
status_at_phase_end: Condition holding (YES-consistent), high confidence. No top-3 jurisdiction banned or licensed open-weight release. Bloc A's October 2022 export rule controlled chips and chip-making items, not model weights; Bloc B's deep-synthesis rules (promulgated in the window, in force 2023-01-10) impose filing on 'technical supporters' and security assessments for tools that edit biometric or sensitive content, which is a conditional requirement on service/tool providers rather than a frontier-tier open-weight licence (owner ruling suggested); a non-top-3 bloc's draft AI regulation excluded pure R&D and deferred general-purpose AI rules to an implementing act. Open-weight releases continued (a 2.1 image model with weights released 2022-12-07).

items.summary: Bloc B regulators published deep-synthesis rules (in force 2023-01-10) requiring 'technical supporters' of generative services to file like providers, and requiring security assessments for models or templates that generate or edit biometric (face, voice) or sensitive non-biometric content. No ban on, or licence for, open release of model weights at a capability tier.
items.detail: CAC/MIIT/MPS Order No. 12, 互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定 (signed 2022-11-25; published on cac.gov.cn 2022-12-11; verified via web_extract this run): Art. 15 (security assessment for models/templates with biometric or national-security-relevant editing functions), Art. 19 (filing by technical supporters), Art. 25 (effective 2023-01-10). Scope Art. 2: providing deep-synthesis internet information services within Bloc B.

items.summary: A non-top-3 regional bloc's Council general approach on its AI regulation excluded AI systems used solely for research and development, and left obligations for general-purpose AI to a later implementing act; no ban or licensing of open-weight release.
items.detail: Council of the Bloc C press release 2022-12-06, 'Artificial Intelligence Act: Council calls for promoting safe AI...' (verified via web_extract this run): general-purpose AI section (requirements via implementing act after consultation and impact assessment); scope excludes national security/defence and 'AI systems and their outputs used for the sole purpose of research and development'.

items.summary: Bloc A's export-control interim final rule licensed exports of advanced AI chips, chip-containing computers and certain chip-manufacturing items (and support for advanced chip production in Bloc B); it did not control model weights or open-weight publication. Comment period was extended in the window.
items.detail: BIS, 'Implementation of Additional Export Controls: Certain Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items...', 87 FR 62186, FR Doc 2022-21658 (verified via web_extract this run): effective 2022-10-07; related document 2022-12-07 'extension of comment period'. Controlled items are ICs, computers, semiconductor manufacturing items and related software/technology ECCNs (3B090, 3D001, 3E001 etc.).

items.summary: An open-weight text-to-image developer released version 2.1 of its model with downloadable checkpoints under a permissive responsible-AI licence, a few weeks after 2.0, stating it is committed to developing future versions in the open - no regulatory barrier to open release observed.
items.detail: Stability AI, 'Stable Diffusion v2.1 and DreamStudio Updates 7-Dec 22' (verified via web_extract this run): weights and model cards on Hugging Face; Hugging Face model card stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2-1 (also opened) shows CreativeML Open RAIL++-M licence.
